scope: Disposable Kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster. Creates one owned namespace, a scaled-to-zero mock Deployment, and a native ValidatingAdmissionPolicy for one synthetic AI asset ConfigMap. Missing and out-of-set sensitivity/criticality/exposure labels are tested through API denial and absence on readback. A valid record is read back, then its classification is updated and read back to show a fixture-only risk-route change. This does not discover assets, establish a real taxonomy, enforce classification on other resource kinds or clusters, create operational tickets, validate regulatory applicability, or prove production governance or response performance.

checks.claim: The API admits an unclassified record before the admission policy is installed
Admission denies missing and out-of-set classification and neither persists
